rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality expanded/hatching blastocyst, but it overstates confidence in a compact A-grade ICM and cohesive TE from a single somewhat soft-focus image where these features are not sharply defined.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor diagnosis, sperm parameters, endometrium, cycle history, and Day 5 status with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with appropriate caveats about untested embryos and transfer factors; only minor overconfidence in image-based morphology limits a perfect score.

Recommendations are well aligned with standard IVF practice: elective single embryo transfer in a young good-prognosis patient, avoidance of unsupported add-ons, and no routine PGT-A in this first-cycle age-27 case.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer management and future planning, though some advice remains general rather than highly case-specific or protocol-specific.
